description: Create a secure voting survey for the '2025 Employee Benefits Vote'. Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!) and create a new survey with this exact title. Configure it for strict privacy and security: (1) Set 'Anonymized responses' to Yes (so votes cannot be linked to voters), (2) Initialize the survey participant table (tokens), (3) Create a custom token attribute named 'EmployeeID' (Description: 'Employee ID Number') so we can track who registered, (4) Enable 'Allow public registration' in Participant Settings so employees can register themselves, and (5) Customize the 'Email to send to registered users' so the subject is 'Your Voting Link - 2025 Benefits' and the body includes the phrase 'Your vote is anonymous'. Activate the survey when finished.
